name: Fitness render diagnostics (scripts/fitness-qa.py)
purpose: Objective checks on a finished film or clip: frame-rate and metadata agreement, A/V sync, frozen frames, black and blank frames, first-frame jump, cuts, motion, repetition rhythm, loudness.

compatibility.runtime: python3.12 or node; ffmpeg where noted
compatibility.notes: Heavy browser steps take the host render lock.

security.notes: Writes only under qa/ or the named output directory.

approval_evidence: tests/test-anatomy3d.py: passes a moving clip, flags a frozen, black, mislabelled one; flagged the stale first frames of the supplied clips (2026-11-13).

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; no third-party code copied.
